sections.title: Afternoon/Evening Shift (14:30 – 22:30)
items: Equipment received: 2 x Swipe Cards, 2 x Vests, 2 x Radio, 2 x Bodycam, 1 x Swipe Key. All photos and videos to be attached to the end-of-shift report.

Response call from 175 Queen Street — a male individual walked in, stole two items and walked out without purchasing; staff have a photo description prepared. Will stop by to collect it and post it into Auror.
Morning Shift changeover successful; now on routes towards the location of interest. Commencing Alpha Route.

Arrived at the response location, Merii and Gifts, and retrieved a photo of the individual. (Photo on file.) The person of interest took the items and ripped the tags off; staff tried to stop him but he became verbally aggressive. Staff felt unsafe and could not stop him from exiting the building.
Patrolling up Queen Street in search of the aggressive male responsible for the theft.
Scoping out the area around Auckland Library, a known hotspot where thieves run to; search unsuccessful.
Response call from management — a male individual apparently under the influence of drugs, shadow boxing and yelling at the corner of the Wyndham Street and Queen Street intersection.
Arrived at the place of interest; the area was thoroughly checked and no concerns identified. Standing by to show presence.

A female individual walked down Wyndham Street from Albert Street yelling and screaming. Spoke with her and asked if she was okay; she showed signs of mental-health distress. Continued standby to ensure a visible presence; welfare check along Chemist Warehouse, all clear.
Arrived at HQ for a quick restroom break before continuing patrols.
Stationed at Elliott Street to ensure a strong security presence.
Arrived at check-in Aotea Square; full sweep of the location, no issues found. Standing by for response calls.
Continuing patrols and catching the red public-transport bus down to the bottom of Queen Street.
Arrived at Imperial Lane; floor checks completed, all clear.

Welfare check along Adidas and McDonald's Britomart, all clear. Arrived at the last checkpoint for Alpha Route, Commercial Bay; full walkthrough around the area with welfare checks on stores and the static guards present, all clear.
Stationed at TK Square to ensure a strong security presence while awaiting response calls. Ending Alpha Route and commencing Delta Route.
Continuing patrols and making our way to the next checkpoint.
Arrived at check-in Kiwibank; welfare checks commenced on all stores within the area, all clear.
Response call from Tribe Hotel — an intoxicated male individual sitting on their outdoor tables and chairs consuming a bottle of soju (alcohol); assistance requested to move the individual along.
Arrived at the response location and asked the male to move along due to the complaints and the alcohol-ban area; he complied without further issues. Standing by to ensure a strong security presence.
Arrived at check-in at the bottom of Fort Street; standing by for response calls.
Response call from The Fox, Viaduct — a group of young individuals causing a disturbance in the area; caller advised assistance was not necessarily needed and the notification was for our awareness.
Arrived at check-in Wilson Carpark; welfare check along 77 Convenience Store, The Right Track, Jo & Joes and Evans Kebab, all clear.
Welfare checks commenced along lower High Street and Vulcan Lane, all clear.
Arrived at check-in Chancery Square; welfare checks commenced on all stores and businesses within the area, all clear.
Continuing patrols as no concerns were identified.
Arrived at HQ; standing by to commence building checks.
Building checks completed. Ending Delta Route; standing by for response calls.
Leaving standby with the Ops Phone at 33%; continuing patrols and ensuring a strong security presence along Queen Street.
Welfare check, all clear; standing by to show presence:
Arrived at check-in Aotea Square, no issues found, all clear. Standing by to show presence.
Continuing patrols as there was no activity requiring our assistance.
Arrived at check-in Elliott Street Apartment; welfare check along Elliott Stables and Atrium on Elliott, making our way up towards the Crowne Plaza Hotel, all clear.
Arrived at check-in at the top of Victoria Street; welfare check along 77 Convenience Store, all clear. Showing presence before moving along.
Welfare check with the train station guard on Victoria Street, all clear.
Patrolling through Elliott Street and Darby Street with welfare checks on stores along the way, all clear.
Arrived at HQ; taking the meal break and preparing for changeover to the Night Shift guards.

Ace Karaoke all clear, no issues to report.

Welfare check at Albert Street Convenience Store, no issues to report.
Albert Street full sweep complete, all clear, no issues to report.

Provedor all clear, no issues to report.

Quay Street all clear, no issues to report.
Patrolling Commercial Bay, commencing full sweep.
Commercial Bay full sweep complete, all clear, no issues to report. Also welfare check at Britomart McDonald's, all clear, no issues.
Full sweep of Fort Street, all clear, no issues to report; welfare check at Jo and Joes, no issues. On standby at Imperial Lane for any nearby calls.
No nearby calls; leaving Fort Street and patrolling up High Street.
Shortland Street all clear, no issues.
High Street all clear, no issues.
Full sweep of Freyberg Square / Chancery Square, all clear, no issues. On standby at Chancery Square showing presence due to a vagrant hanging around outside the Memorial Hall.
No issues at Freyberg Square / Chancery Square. Patrolling Kitchener Street.
Kitchener Street all clear, no issues to report. Heading down Wellesley Street.
Wellesley Street all clear, no issues to report.
Welfare check at Queen Street McDonald's, no issues to report. Heading back to HQ for a 30-minute break.
Arrived at HQ, commencing a 30-minute break.

flags: NOTE: 18:16 The Fox (Viaduct) disturbance call was advisory only — caller stated attendance was not required; not counted in calls.
NOTE: 14:51 management call (male on drugs shadow boxing at Wyndham/Queen) attended 14:57 but subject not located; counted as a call, not as an intoxicated person dealt with.
